data.long_meaning: The meaning of Charon is recorded in name-lists as “Ferryman of the dead”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Charon expresses “Ferryman of the dead”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Charon total 32, reducing to 5. Number 5 is associated with freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
